title: incidents
text:
incidents

Asha Patel: FYI — scheduling the post-incident review for the S3-backed model cache outage. Need a facilitator, a note-taker, and confirmation of who from product + infra can attend. (impact window ~ 02:15-02:42 UTC)

Devon Li: I can facilitate if nobody else has bandwidth. Throwing my hat in — availability tomorrow 09:30-11:00 PT and 15:00-16:30 PT.

Marina Ortiz: I can take notes if Devon facilitates. Also will bring the canary roll logs and the KV-cache eviction traces.

Tom Brenner: I'll be there for infra context. Prefer 16:00 PT.

Asha Patel: Thanks. Can we confirm PM presence? @Emma Cole are you able to make either slot?

Emma Cole: I’m with the PM (Jae) — we can make 09:30 PT. PM wants a short agenda: timeline, root cause hypotheses, action items, rollback/fallback changes.

Asha Patel: Great. Sounds like Devon facil + Marina notes + Tom infra + Emma/PM. I’ll book 09:30 PT for 60m. Posting the draft agenda and the postmortem doc link below.

incident-bot: Incident #2026-03-14-57 created: S3 cache eviction caused degraded responses. Pagerduty alert triggered at 02:17 UTC, resolved at 02:42 UTC. Summary doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-14-57

Devon Li: Agenda suggestion: 1) quick timeline (5m) 2) what changed + why caching evicted (10m) 3) mitigation and why it worked (10m) 4) root cause analysis and hypotheses (15m) 5) action items + owners + due dates (15m) 6) follow-ups (5m)

Marina Ortiz: Adding that we should include token-level latency curves and the KV cache hit-rate pre/post. I’ll upload charts to the doc before the meeting.

Tom Brenner: Reminder: oncall handoff notes show there was an automated eviction triggered by the memory-pressure monitor. Need to include the monitor thresholds and the scale test that crossed them.

Asha Patel: Okay — facilitator = Devon, scribe = Marina. Meeting booked: 2026-03-15 09:30 PT / 16:30 UTC, 60m. Calendar invite sent.

Devon Li: I’ll draft the facilitator checklist: intro + scope, keep us on timeline, ensure we capture decisions and assign owners. Also I’ll run the RCA whiteboard for hypotheses.

Marina Ortiz: Uploaded charts and raw logs to the doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-14-57/data (please avoid editing the raw logs).

Asha Patel: Required attendees: SRE (Devon, Emma), Infra (Tom), Runtime eng (Marina), PM (Jae), Support lead (Linh). Optional: Solutions eng + product security. If you see anyone missing ping them.

Emma Cole: Linh can join for the first 30m. PM will stay the whole time.

Tom Brenner: Quick ask — Can we capture the mitigation timeline in actionable detail? E.g., exact commands and who ran them. That helps the runbook update.

Marina Ortiz: Yep, I’ll paste the mitigation shell snippet into the doc: ```sudo systemctl restart redwood-cache && flush_kv_cache --shards 0-3``` and tag the executor (oncall).

Asha Patel: Action item template in the doc is: "Action: <what> | Owner: <name> | Due: <YYYY-MM-DD> | Status: open". Please pre-fill any obvious items before the meeting.

Devon Li: I prefilled three items: increase memory-pressure threshold on non-prod (Owner: Tom, Due: 2026-03-22), add clearer alert text for automated evictions (Owner: SRE Alerts team, Due: 2026-03-18), update runbook with mitigation steps + commands (Owner: Marina, Due: 2026-03-17).

Tom Brenner: Confirming owner for threshold change. I’ll take it.

Marina Ortiz: Taking the runbook update. I’ll include the exact commands and a short playbook for verification.

Asha Patel: Good. Devon — can you volunteer to capture the decision notes and publish the final postmortem doc the same day? We want to close the loop fast for the customer comms team.

Devon Li: Yes — I’ll publish the draft within 4 hours after the meeting and ping #customer-comms for notification.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation note — Emma Cole is primary for 2026-03-15 00:00-08:00 UTC.

Asha Patel: One more: please review the attendee list and mark required/optional in the calendar. If you cannot attend, add a delegate who can speak to the subsystem.

Emma Cole: Marked required. Linh (support) added as optional backup for the comms bit.

Marina Ortiz: Small follow-up — telemetry shows increased write latency right before eviction. I’ll add a short hypothesis section: heavy write burst + small eviction window + threshold too tight.

Devon Li: During the meeting I’ll ask for an explicit decision on whether to change threshold vs add a secondary protective guard (exponential backoff for eviction). We should capture tradeoffs and rollout steps.

Asha Patel: Thanks everyone. Post-incident meeting link and doc in the calendar invite. If anything urgent pops up, flag here and we can move to the later slot. :white_check_mark: 

Tom Brenner: :eyes: see you all tomorrow.

Devon Li: Thanks — I’ll share the facilitator checklist in the doc and pin it here before EOD.

Marina Ortiz: Thanks, team. I’ll make sure charts are embedded and the KV eviction trace is annotated.

incident-bot: Postmortem meeting created: 2026-03-15 09:30 PT. Action items added to tracker."
